parts.text:
Participants were woken at two different time intervals during REM sleep and asked to
estimate their dream-duration. One of the time intervals was five minutes.
State the other time interval.

parts.text: Name the apparatus used to measure brain activity in this study.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Outline one dream reported by a participant that had horizontal eye movements.

parts.text: Describe the shock generator used in this study.

parts.label: (b)

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Outline the aim of this study.

text: From the study by Andrade (doodling):
The debate about individual and situational explanations relates to the study by Schachter and
Singer (two factors in emotion).
Outline what is meant by this debate. Include one example from the individual explanation and
one example from the situational explanation from the study by Schachter and Singer.
From the study by Laney et al. (false memory):
Describe the procedure from the point when participants had to view slides in Experiment 2.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Outline how participants were asked to respond to pictures during the recognition test in this
study.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Two friends, Govinda and Ansh, are discussing this study in terms of validity.
Govinda believes the study does have validity but Ansh believes the study does not have
validity.
Outline why you think either Govinda or Ansh is correct, using evidence from the study.

helping).

(chimpanzee helping):

reward ______
species ______
